# Tax intake workflow

Source: [adw_tax_intake.py](adw_tax_intake.py). This workflow checks one document
folder per run by default. It asks about missing information and records your answers.

Open this file in VS Code with **Ctrl+Shift+V**. The embedded images work offline.
Each **Mermaid source** section contains editable code. Images must be regenerated
when the code changes.

## 1. Read, review, save

`--folder NAME` revisits a specific folder. Otherwise, the workflow selects folders
without `intake_notes.txt`, up to `--limit` (default: 1). It reads existing JSON/Markdown
and `concerns.md`; the intake agent does not see the scanned page.

![Read, review, save][workflow-image-1]

<details>
<summary>Mermaid source</summary>

```text
sequenceDiagram
    actor You
    participant ADW as Workflow
    participant Files as Document folders
    participant Intake as Intake agent
    You->>ADW: Start intake
    ADW->>Files: Select folders
    loop Each selected folder
        ADW->>Files: Read existing text
        Files-->>ADW: Extraction and concerns
        ADW->>Intake: What is missing or unclear?
        Intake-->>ADW: Findings and questions
        ADW->>ADW: Review folder (diagram 2)
        ADW->>Files: Append intake_notes.txt
    end
    ADW->>Files: Rebuild INTAKE_STATUS.txt
    ADW-->>You: Finish with a summary
```

</details>

If no folder matches, it only rebuilds the status list and finishes. Each run is
logged in an ADW session. Notes are appended after review, even without approval.
The saved status is `complete` only if the agent said complete **and** you approved;
otherwise it is `needs_info`. Answers do not trigger another intake-agent check.

**“Done” in the status list means a notes file exists.** Unanswered folders leave
the automatic queue too. Use `--folder NAME` to revisit them.

## 2. Answer the questions

For each question, `e` asks the explanation agent for help using the existing text;
`s` shows the scanned document (diagram 3). Both return to the same question.
A blank answer leaves that question open.

![Answer the questions][workflow-image-2]

<details>
<summary>Mermaid source</summary>

```text
sequenceDiagram
    actor You
    participant ADW as Workflow
    ADW-->>You: Show findings
    loop Each question, until answered or left blank
        ADW-->>You: Answer, e for help, or s to show
        You->>ADW: Your reply
        alt e or s
            ADW-->>You: Explain or show, then ask again
        else Answer or blank
            ADW->>ADW: Keep reply for the notes
        end
    end
    ADW-->>You: Mark folder reviewed? [y/N]
    You->>ADW: Yes or no
    ADW-->>You: Any other notes?
    You->>ADW: Notes or blank
```

</details>

Approval and notes return to diagram 1 for saving. With `--auto-decision approve`,
the workflow skips all questions and prompts and records approval without answers.

## 3. Show the page

The helper uses the first scanned file in the folder (the first page for a PDF).
No scanned file means a message and a return to the question.

![Show the page][workflow-image-3]

<details>
<summary>Mermaid source</summary>

```text
sequenceDiagram
    participant ADW as Workflow
    participant Helper as Page helper
    participant Vision as Location agent
    ADW->>Helper: Find question amounts or numbers with OCR
    Helper-->>ADW: Region or no match
    opt No OCR match
        ADW->>Vision: Locate a region on the page
        Vision-->>ADW: Region or no match
    end
    ADW->>Helper: Open boxed copy, or original, in Windows
```

</details>

A red box is added to a temporary copy when possible. If opening fails, the program
prints a message. You then answer the same question in diagram 2.
